content.text:
Mobile does not yet have rendering or tool-loop parity with web. It has a sound local learner-record foundation, but its chat path is text-only plus three legacy inline cards.

| Capability | Web | Mobile now | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown | `react-markdown` + GFM, math/KaTeX, spoiler transform, tables, highlighted/runnable code | Hand-rolled headings (H1-H3), bullets, quote, bold, inline/fenced code, spoilers, basic markdown links | No italic/strike/task lists/tables/autolinks/escaping/nested blocks, math, syntax highlighting, runnable code, streamed-fence state, or image Markdown |
| Mermaid | Dynamic Mermaid, strict security mode, sanitized SVG, error fallback, fullscreen/dialog | A `mermaid` fence is displayed as ordinary code, including generated concept maps | No diagram rendering, safe SVG pipeline, zoom/fullscreen, or accessible fallback |
| Citations | Web-search tool result has source extraction/status/error UI, Markdown links open safely in browser context | Markdown links only; citation data has no structured renderer | No citation cards/provenance, source count/status, or tool-result association |
| Assistant images/media | Image/tool parts and artifact/media viewers exist | User attachment previews only; no assistant Markdown images, generated images, animation/audio/video renderer | No remote-media policy, caching, content-type limits, or native playback/handoff |
| OpenUI | `@openuidev/react-lang`, fenced-block segmentation, streaming commit boundary, local state lifecycle, action event bridge | Only `<keating-quiz|question|goal>` parser and native cards | No OpenUI fence parser/runtime, StudyPlan/deck/artifact/image/media/handoff documents, state revisions, actions, or recovery |
| Tool calls | Agent emits request/start/progress/result; panel folds result onto call and has special web-search rendering | `streamCompletion` extracts text deltas only; requests send no tools; native message model has no tool role/call ID | No visible tool ledger, no tool execution loop, no cancellation-safe correlation, no import-preserving tool transcripts |

Primary evidence: [mobile MarkdownText](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MarkdownText.tsx:7), [mobile MessageContent](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MessageContent.tsx:27), [mobile provider stream](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:381), [web Markdown](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/MarkdownBlock.tsx:208), [web Mermaid](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/MermaidRenderer.tsx:160), [web OpenUI renderer](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/openui/renderer.tsx:75), and [web tool lifecycle](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/integration/agent-events.ts:48).

The shared `@keating/learner-contracts` is the right native boundary, but neither UI currently consumes its canonical `UiDocument` / `UiAction` / `AgentStreamEvent` path:

- It already defines versioned native-safe documents for Markdown, questions, quiz, goals, decks, artifacts, images, media, and handoffs, plus idempotent action journals and ordered tool streams: [ui contract](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/packages/learner-contracts/src/ui.ts:47), [stream contract](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/packages/learner-contracts/src/stream.ts:20).
- Mobile imports the package only for portable learner data, SRS, and cards. It does not import the UI or stream types.
- Web has a separate legacy `web/src/keating/ui-protocol/` and its OpenUI event bridge adapts into that protocol, not `@keating/learner-contracts`: [bridge](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/integration/ui-actions.ts:15). Do not make mobile copy that third schema.
- The current mobile portable projection explicitly excludes sessions with `toolCallId` / non-user-or-assistant roles, so tool transcripts would otherwise disappear after export/import: [projection boundary](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/learner-repository/portable-native-state.ts:92).

Recommended dependency-safe sequence:

1. **Contract and event storage first.** Extend/fixture-test `packages/learner-contracts/src/ui.ts` and `stream.ts` only if a missing node/action is discovered. Add mobile SQLite storage for canonical documents, action journals, and stream events before changing chat rendering. Update [portable-native-state](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/learner-repository/portable-native-state.ts:92) to retain compatible tool/document data, or preserve unprojected records explicitly rather than silently dropping them.

2. **Build the native agent runner/tool ledger.** Add a provider-neutral adapter beside [provider-client](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:381), wire it through [KeatingProvider](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:50), and persist ordered text/tool/result/error events. Show a compact call card with name, progress, expandable redacted arguments/result, retry state, and call-ID correlation. Continue to allow text-only providers, with an explicit “tools unavailable” capability state.

3. **Replace the ad-hoc card parser at the boundary, not card-by-card.** Add a native `UiDocumentRenderer` and `UiActionDispatcher` that consume validated contract documents. Adapt existing `QuestionCard`, `QuizCard`, and `GoalCard` first, preserving their durable-record-before-success behavior. Keep legacy tag parsing only as a migration adapter and render a complete Markdown fallback for unsupported docs/actions.

4. **Introduce a real native Markdown AST renderer.** Replace [MarkdownText](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MarkdownText.tsx:38) with a platform-neutral parser plus React Native renderers. Do not import `react-markdown`, `rehype-katex`, or DOM code into Metro. Required capabilities: GFM tables/tasks/strike, nested lists, links, fenced code state, inline/block math, citations, image nodes, and bounded parsing. Current mobile dependencies include neither a Markdown parser, a math renderer, syntax highlighter, Mermaid runtime, OpenUI runtime, nor WebView.

5. **Mermaid and media after the document renderer.** Mermaid’s browser runtime is DOM-based and cannot be reused in Expo. Use a constrained renderer strategy:
   - native textual fallback plus source-copy immediately;
   - then an authenticated server-produced, size-bounded SVG/image with a strict sanitizer and `react-native-svg` renderer, or a restricted WebView only if separately added and security-reviewed.
   - Treat Hyperframes/video/audio as a typed `media` document with native playback only where available, otherwise an explicit handoff carrying context. Do not execute model-authored HTML or JavaScript.

6. **Web adapter convergence.** Convert OpenUI fences and existing web tool events into the shared contract in `web/src/keating/openui/segments.ts`, `web/src/keating/integration/ui-actions.ts`, and `agent-events.ts`, while retaining the web OpenUI renderer as one adapter. This makes the native app receive documents/actions, not web-specific source language.

Security boundaries to retain:

- Mobile Markdown currently calls `Linking.openURL()` directly for model-authored URLs ([line 57](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/MarkdownText.tsx:57)); route all untrusted links through one allowlist/confirmation helper. `openProductLink` is recoverable, but it also needs a fixed-origin or scheme policy before reuse.
- The contract already rejects `file:`, credential-bearing, query/hash-bearing, and arbitrary HTTP resource URIs while allowing HTTPS, artifact IDs, and loopback: [validator](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/packages/learner-contracts/src/ui.ts:214), [tests](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/packages/learner-contracts/test/interactive-contracts.test.ts:137). Apply that before any image/media fetch or handoff.
- Keep provider keys in SecureStore only. Tool arguments/results, OpenUI state, portable exports, and diagnostics must be JSON-safe/redacted and bounded.
- Never give the native app implicit local host-write ability. A remote workspace path must expose only declared capability operations and require visible diff confirmation.

Tests and device gates:

- Unit: `packages/learner-contracts/test/interactive-contracts.test.ts` for document/action/event ordering, idempotency, bad resource URIs, secrets, and unavailable capability recovery.
- Add `mobile/test/markdown-rendering.test.ts` with GFM/math/code/image/citation/invalid-link fixtures; `mobile/test/ui-document-renderer.test.ts`; `mobile/test/agent-stream.test.ts`; `mobile/test/mermaid-media-policy.test.ts`; and update `learner-portable-native-state.test.ts` for tool/document round trips.
- Static: `bun run --cwd mobile typecheck`, `bun test ./test/*.test.ts` from `mobile`, package contract tests, Android export/build.
- Physical Android and iPhone gates: 320×568 and 390px-class narrow widths; light/dark; large text; TalkBack/VoiceOver focus order; keyboard-over-composer; slow streaming with an unfinished OpenUI document; tool call success/error/retry/cancel/background-resume; Mermaid success/error/fallback; citation and blocked-link confirmation; image/media size/network failure; force-kill/reopen with a pending action. Verify that imported web tool/doc sessions remain inspectable rather than being excluded.

This matches the repo’s accepted cross-platform architecture: native renderers consume shared contracts, while browser/DOM runtimes stay out of Metro. [build plan](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/plans/cross-platform-parity-build.md:204)
